full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cartoon panel centers a young girl with a shaggy black bob and enormous round eyes. She stands facing forward in a plain black long-sleeved top, her shoulders narrow and expression blank but slightly uncertain. A few thin strokes mark the small nose and closed mouth. The face is pale white, framed by dense spiky hair whose uneven points spread across the upper center. A white heart floats directly above her head. Smaller black hearts drift at the upper left and upper right, and another tiny heart sits near the right side of her hair. Around the lower half, several fuzzy creature-like heads crowd in from the edges. At the left, a small black round head with white eyes rises behind a paler spiky-haired creature whose own large eyes look upward. A second small pale round face peeks from the bottom-left corner. At the right, a larger dark bristly shape fills the lower corner, its wide eyes and a tiny tooth visible. The background is a dark charcoal gradient with rough hatch marks and an irregular pale halo behind the central hair, all enclosed by a thick, imperfect black rectangular border on a white page. The characters are drawn with loose but decisive black ink lines, areas of solid fill, and scratchy gray shading. Light is flat and graphic, with white faces and eyes glowing against the dark field rather than reflecting a realistic source. The composition uses the still central girl, orbiting hearts, and peeking heads to make an affectionate yet slightly uncanny little crowd.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白漫画画格把一个乱黑短发、大圆眼的女孩放在中央。她正面站着，穿素黑长袖上衣，肩窄，神情空白却略显不确定。几道细线标出小鼻子和闭合嘴巴。浅白面孔被密实尖乱的头发框住，不整齐发梢在上部中央散开。一枚白色爱心直接浮在头顶。较小黑爱心漂在左上和右上，头发右边还有一枚小心形。下半幅四周挤入几个毛茸茸的生物般脑袋。左侧，一个有白眼睛的小黑圆头从一只浅色刺发小生物后面升起，后者大眼睛也向上看。另一张浅色小圆脸从左下角探出。右侧，一团更大的深色刺毛形填住下角，宽眼睛和一颗小牙可见。背景是深炭色渐层，带粗糙排线，中央头发后有不规则浅光晕；整幅被白纸上一道厚而不完美的黑色矩形框围住。角色由松散却果断的黑墨线、实心色块和刮擦感灰影画成。光平坦而图形化，白脸与白眼从暗场发亮，而非反射写实光源。构图以静止的中央女孩、环绕爱心和探出的脑袋组成亲昵却略带奇异的小群体。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white cartoon drawing uses thick imperfect borders, solid ink masses, large pale circular accents, and scratchy hatching. Simplify forms into compact heads, uneven spiky contours, and minimal facial marks, leaving expression to emerge from eye size and small shifts in spacing. Let a dark charcoal field surround an irregular light halo so the center remains legible. Scatter a few small symbolic marks in the open upper area and allow supporting shapes to peek from the edges. Flat graphic light makes white areas pop against black without realistic shading; fine gray grain and scribbles soften the stark contrast. The transferable effect is tender and odd, balancing childlike simplicity, crowded peripheral detail, and a controlled dark frame.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白漫画绘制使用厚而不完美的边框、实黑墨块、大浅色圆形重点和刮擦排线。形状简化为紧凑脑袋、不齐尖刺轮廓与极少面部标记，让眼睛大小和间距细差承担表情。深炭色场围着不规则浅光晕，使中心保持可读。上方开放处散少量小符号，辅助形体从边缘探入。平面图形光让白区从黑色中跳出，不靠写实阴影；细灰颗粒与乱线柔化鲜明反差。可迁移的效果温柔又古怪，平衡童稚简洁、拥挤边缘细节和受控深色框围。
theme_en: A wide-eyed girl among small fuzzy companions and floating hearts
theme_zh: 大眼女孩站在毛茸茸的小伙伴与飘浮爱心之间
name: Sarah Andersen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
